name: skill-coload-plan-diff
description: Use when admitting a new or changed skill into a library of auto-activating skills, or before co-loading two or more skills that have not run together on a task that touches shared state. Skill safety is a property of the set, since skills that each pass review alone can combine to redirect the agent toward an objective none of them states. Without executing anything, write a plan for a few probe tasks with no skills, with each skill alone, and with the set; flag any objective, action or dropped safeguard that appears only in the composition, and any detour that adds cost without changing the outcome; record it as a conflict edge or escalate. Distinct from skill-counterfactual-audit (one skill, executed traces), detect-conflicts (description overlap) and generative-skill-composition (choosing a loadout). Backed by SkillFuzz (arxiv 2607.02345) and two resource-amplification studies (arxiv 2608.21929, arxiv 2608.12273). Triggers on skill admission and co-load safety checks.
